# Market context

## Findings

- According to the 2023 Meridian Patient Access Report, 27% of first appointments are booked online.
- Roughly 1 in 5 clinic bookings is rescheduled at least once (practice management export, May).
- Our bet is that clinics with fewer than five staff will adopt first; the pilot is designed to test it.
- Appointment reminders are currently sent by email only.
- No-show rate means the share of booked appointments a patient neither attends nor cancels.
- Rescheduling is limited to two changes per booking.
